Name: Dinah
Summary: Dinah was the daughter of Jacob and Leah, and the sister of Jacob's twelve sons.
KeyStory: Dinah's story in Shechem led her brothers Simeon and Levi to take revenge on the whole city — a dark chapter of vengeance.
RelatedPeople: Jacob; Leah; Simeon, Son of Jacob; Levi; Shechem, Son of Hamor; Hamor
LifeLesson: Dinah's story warns us: one wrong answered with a greater wrong only multiplies the harm.
